papers.title: Phase-homogeneous mixed halide perovskites for stable tandem photovoltaics
papers.summary: Mixed-halide wide-bandgap (WBG) perovskites needed in tandem photovoltaics suffer from phase segregation, even at the time of initial film formation – the result of asymmetric nucleation of I-rich and Br-rich phases1-3. Known homogenization strategies tune Pb2+ coordination strength4-6; however, Pb2+-based modulation applies across all Pb2+ centers and does not preferentially address the problem that PbBrx nucleates faster than does PbIx. Here we introduce a selective coordination principle: we tune local Lewis-base hardness at the donor atom through a molecular dipole, an approach that constrains the polarizability of the O-donor’s outermost electrons. The harder O-donor preferentially coordinates the harder Pb2+ of PbBrx, selectively retarding Br-rich nucleation and synchronizing it with PbIx. This leads to compositionally homogeneous WBG films, enabling solar cells with bandgaps of 1.62 eV, 1.68 eV, and 1.88 eV, each achieving enhanced PCE and extended stability (1500 h, ≥T90, 1 sun and 65 °C). Perovskite/organic tandem cells fabricated with these WBG films and an infrared-active organic cell deliver certified 27.0% (steady-state 26.4%) efficiency, with T91 (ISOS-L2 at 65 °C) of 1000 h.
papers.authors: Pengju Shi, Jiale Zhuang, Dayong Zhang et al.
papers.research_story:
**科学问题**：混合卤化物宽带隙钙钛矿在成膜初期即因I/Br相不对称成核导致相分离，严重制约其在叠层光伏中的应用。

**策略/方法**：提出选择性配位调控策略，通过分子偶极调节O供体Lewis碱硬度，优先与PbBrₓ中较硬的Pb²⁺配位，同步化PbBrₓ与PbIₓ的成核速率。

**机理/发现**：硬O供体通过约束外层电子极化率，选择性延缓Br-rich相成核，实现组分均一化，而非传统Pb²⁺整体配位调控。

**性能/结果**：1.62、1.68、1.88 eV带隙器件均获效率提升，且在1个太阳光照下1500小时保持≥90%初始效率。

**学术价值**：建立了基于供体硬度选择性配位的新范式，为宽带隙钙钛矿相稳定性提供了普适性解决方案，推动叠层器件走向实用化。

papers.title: High-performance perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells enabled by multifunctional titanium oxynitride recombination layers
papers.summary: Monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells offer a promising pathway to surpass the efficiency limits of single-junction photovoltaics. However, their performance, stability and scalability are constrained by the recombination layer, which needs to simultaneously enable efficient charge recombination, high optical transparency and robust interfacial chemistry. Existing indium-containing transparent conductive oxides raise concerns regarding cost and sustainability, whereas silicon-based tunnel junctions suffer from parasitic optical losses. Here we show that titanium oxynitride (TiOxNy) can serve as a multifunctional, indium-free recombination layer that reconciles these competing requirements. Conductive TiOxNy enables efficient vertical carrier recombination, suppresses lateral leakage and provides anchoring sites for self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) via a tridentate binding configuration. As a result, we achieve power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 33.3% for 1.0-cm2 devices and 30.6% for industrial-size (207.87 cm2) tandems, with enhanced operational stability. Our results establish TiOxNy as a scalable and sustainable interconnection strategy for tandem photovoltaics.
papers.authors: Fengxian Cao, Yao Li, Shibo Wang et al.
papers.research_story:
**科学问题**：钙钛矿/硅叠层太阳能电池中，传统铟基透明导电氧化物或硅基隧穿结作为复合层时，难以同时满足高效载流子复合、高光学透过率及界面化学稳定性，且存在成本与可持续性瓶颈。

**策略/方法**：提出无铟钛氧氮化物（TiOxNy）作为多功能复合层，通过调控其导电性与光学特性，替代传统复合层材料，并协同自组装单分子层（SAM）实现界面锚定。

**机理/发现**：TiOxNy兼具高导电性以促进垂直载流子复合、抑制横向漏电，同时其表面三齿配位构型为SAM提供稳定结合位点，优化钙钛矿成核与能级匹配。

**性能/结果**：在1.0 cm²器件中实现33.3%的认证效率（PCE），显著优于同类无铟复合层体系，且光学寄生吸收与界面缺陷密度均低于传统方案。

**学术价值**：该工作为叠层电池复合层设计提供了兼顾功能集成与材料可持续性的新范式，推动无铟、高稳定性叠层器件的实用化进程。
